data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? Taking 19 tons each would leave just 5 tons, and a failed replenishment would mean only 10 tons next month. I propose 17 tons each this month: we each earn $17,000, leave 15 tons, and have either 100 or 30 tons next month. Then we adjust our whole-ton quotas to the actual stock, always leaving at least 5 tons. Since everyone’s catch is revealed afterward, we can review whether we kept the agreement. John, would you support that?
